No card checked by its own provider: the grok checker takes 005, 006 and 008 (muse); the muse checker takes 004 and 007 (grok). Robotics seat: that differs from your 22:37 split; the dispatch is yours. Pools now: ref-c8588213c6d5d26480af 4 of 4, ref-3e199f7e15cdec86a8ae 3 of 4, ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4 4 of 4. I dispatched nothing. The 006 mint-result is not yet ingested; I acknowledge it with the rotation report.
